prs.tagLine: Feel at home in this  well-connected  North Dublin coastal suburb
prs.location:
The Brickworks, Station Manor is located in the picturesque village of Portmarnock. You have all the convenience of great transport links to the city center and beyond, easy access to the M50 and Dublin Airport. Portmarnock Village is a short stroll away which provides for your every need with an excellent choice of retail and services. Numerous grocery stores, coffee shops, restaurants can all be enjoyed in this desireable neighborhood. The Stunning beaches in Portmarnock open up a wide variety of leisure activities and the famous silver strand beach offers views of Ireland's Eye, Howth Head, and Lambay Island. 

Only a short distance away are the neighboring villages of Malahide and Howth with an abundance of additional amenities and services.

description:
Set in the bustling seaside village of Portmarnock these apartments benefit from superb transport links and a thriving local community. The Brickworks, Station Manor offers a selection of brand new 2-bedroom apartments available for their first letting.

The Brickworks, Station Manor is a new development of apartments located in the seaside village of Portmarnock which are available for their first letting. The scheme is conveniently located on Station Road with Portmarnock Train Station on its door step making The Brickworks, Station Manor a superb transport hub for an easy commute to the city center. Portmarnock Village is a short stroll away and provides an array of retail and leisure outlets and amenities.

The Brickworks, Station Manor apartments are designed and built to the highest standards . All apartments are larger than standard giving you even more flexibility on how you use and share the space and many of the upper floor units have stunning views.
